newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian tin ends steady on technical support.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian tin ends steady on technical support.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price ended unchanged at 13.67 ringgit ($5.42) a kg on Thursday and traders said the steadiness reflected renewed support for the metal after recent corrections.
"I think current price is still low and should reach about 13.75 if the LME is strong tonight," said a trader.
Buyers from Europe, Japan and Malaysia ignored a slight overnight fall on the London Metal Exchange and matched positions for a turnover of 87 tonnes on the tin market.
